media.ogImageAlt: Luxury primary bedroom featuring warm wood paneling, an upholstered headboard, herringbone flooring, and custom built-in shelving.

content.description:
This bedroom remodel creates a warm, tailored retreat with a refined balance of softness, structure, and modern luxury. Layered wood wall paneling wraps the room in warmth, while the oversized upholstered headboard brings comfort, scale, and quiet elegance to the sleeping area. A marble-accented shelving wall, sculptural lounge chair, and integrated dressing zone add a custom, high-end feel without overwhelming the space.

The design uses a calm neutral palette, herringbone wood flooring, soft textiles, and curated lighting to create an atmosphere that feels both intimate and sophisticated. Contemporary pendant lights, a tray ceiling with sleek black track lighting, and rounded wardrobe detailing introduce architectural interest while maintaining a clean, restful mood. The result is a polished bedroom sanctuary designed for elevated everyday living.

projects.title: Modern Marble Haven
projects.resolvedTitle: Modern Marble Haven | Fort Lauderdale, FL | Sarvian Design Group

openGraph.title: Modern Marble Haven | Fort Lauderdale, FL
openGraph.description: A luxury Fort Lauderdale, Florida bathroom design blending modern minimalist style with warm walnut tones, dramatic fluted marble walls, and brushed gold fixtures.

media.ogImageAlt: Modern luxury bathroom vanity and makeup station featuring a floating walnut cabinet, a thick calacatta marble countertop with a rectangular vessel sink, brushed gold hardware, and a large backlit mirror framed by dark metal trim against fluted marble walls.

content.description:
This primary bathroom remodel is designed as a serene, spa-inspired retreat, where fluted marble wall panels create movement, texture, and quiet drama throughout the space. Soft veining flows seamlessly across the floors, walls, shower, and vanity surfaces, giving the room a monolithic architectural quality, while warm walnut cabinetry and brushed gold fixtures add balance and sophistication. The freestanding soaking tub stands as a sculptural focal point, framed by sheer drapery and soft lighting for an atmosphere that feels refined, calming, and deeply luxurious.



Every detail of the layout was considered to elevate daily living—from the floating dual vanities and integrated storage to the glass-enclosed shower and custom stone-lined shelving. The deliberate contrast of fluted marble, rich wood tones, and premium hardware brings a modern yet timeless sensibility to the space. The result is a polished example of luxury residential design, blending elegant materiality with effortless functionality and the elevated craftsmanship expected in South Florida interior design.

content.description:
This custom luxury residence was designed to create a seamless connection between architecture, interiors, and the surrounding landscape. Defined by expansive floor-to-ceiling glazing, soaring double-height spaces, and clean architectural lines, the home is filled with natural light while maintaining a warm, inviting atmosphere. The open-concept layout encourages effortless movement between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating an environment equally suited for everyday living and sophisticated entertaining.



The interior palette balances timeless elegance with contemporary refinement through the use of natural white oak, richly veined stone, custom millwork, and dark architectural accents. Every detail was carefully considered to achieve a sense of understated luxury, where texture, proportion, and craftsmanship take center stage. The result is a residence that feels both refined and comfortable, offering a harmonious blend of modern design, functional living, and a strong connection to the outdoors.

content.description:
This Golden Beach, Florida property remodel reimagines the residence as a refined example of tropical modern homes, blending bold architectural lines with the relaxed elegance of South Florida living. The exterior features expansive glass, warm natural stone, dark linear accents, and deep roof overhangs that create a striking yet balanced façade. Lush palms, layered greenery, and discreet privacy walls soften the modern structure, giving the home a private resort-like presence ideal for a luxury coastal neighborhood.



Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the remodel emphasizes light, scale, and connection to the landscape. Floor-to-ceiling windows, glass balconies, and open terraces invite natural light while framing views of the tropical surroundings. The result is a sophisticated Golden Beach residence that reflects South Florida architecture at its best: clean, elegant, and contemporary, with a strong sense of privacy, comfort, and luxury home design.

content.description:
Nestled in the vibrant heart of Aventura, Florida, this residence showcases the pinnacle of upscale Miami living through a refined and modern interior design approach. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the home with natural light, accentuating its clean architectural lines and highlighting the interplay of textures and finishes. The open-concept floor plan effortlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, where custom millwork, sleek cabinetry, and a waterfall-edge island create a space that is both functional and visually striking.



Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to balance comfort and sophistication. A palette of soft neutrals is enriched by warm wood tones, metallic accents, and luxurious fabrics, adding depth and visual interest to each room. Statement lighting fixtures, bespoke furnishings, and carefully selected art pieces elevate the atmosphere, reflecting a cosmopolitan sensibility. Located just moments from world-class shopping, fine dining, and the sparkling waters of the Intracoastal, this Aventura home is a masterclass in blending modern elegance with the ease of coastal living.

projects.title: South Beach
projects.resolvedTitle: South Beach | Miami, Florida | Sarvian Design Group
projects.metaDescription: Miami Beach interior design project blending coastal sophistication, tropical modern styling, bespoke furnishings, natural textures, and ocean-inspired details.

openGraph.title: South Beach | Miami, Florida
openGraph.description: Miami Beach interior design project blending coastal sophistication, tropical modern styling, bespoke furnishings, natural textures, and ocean-inspired details.

content.description:
Beneath the soft South Beach sunlight, this interior radiates an effortless blend of coastal sophistication and modern luxury. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows invite the ocean breeze, casting natural light over sleek white walls and warm, sand-toned flooring. The open-plan layout flows seamlessly from lounge to dining, anchored by bespoke contemporary furnishings in muted neutrals, accented with oceanic blues and textured linens. Statement lighting pieces—sculptural yet understated—float above conversation areas, while carefully curated artwork reflects the vibrancy of Miami’s art scene. Every element is designed for balance, pairing clean lines with organic forms to create a serene yet dynamic environment.



The interior decoration speaks to the heart of Tropical Modern living, layering tactile materials and lush greenery to bring the outdoors in. Woven rattan accents, polished stone surfaces, and rich hardwood details create depth and warmth, while indoor planters with exotic foliage soften the architectural lines. Decorative accessories are minimal yet purposeful—ceramic vessels, artisan-made trays, and glass sculptures—allowing the space to breathe while telling a story of refined coastal living. This is not just a residence; it’s an immersive South Beach experience where modern design meets the rhythm of the sea, perfectly crafted for those who seek both beauty and tranquility.

openGraph.title: Old River | Miami, Florida
openGraph.description: Miami tropical modern residence featuring indoor-outdoor living, architectural lighting, lush landscaping, poolside entertaining, and refined South Florida design.

content.description:
Set in the heart of Miami, this Tropical Modern residence is a masterclass in seamless indoor-outdoor living. The home’s striking geometric lines are softened by warm wood accents, expansive glass facades, and lush tropical landscaping. By day, sunlight pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, while at dusk, the residence glows with architectural lighting that accentuates its clean silhouettes. The entry pathway, framed by manicured lavender beds and swaying palms, leads to a minimalist façade that blends natural textures with crisp modern forms. Each exterior space is thoughtfully curated, creating a serene, resort-like atmosphere that feels both exclusive and welcoming.



The outdoor living experience centers around a spectacular pool deck, where reflective water mirrors the evening sky and subtle lighting transforms the space into a private sanctuary. Sleek lounge seating, shaded dining areas, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen make this the ultimate setting for entertaining. The design embraces Miami’s tropical climate, using breezeways, shaded overhangs, and open-air pavilions to ensure comfort and elegance year-round. Every detail—from the strategic placement of palm trees to the integration of natural stone and contemporary furnishings—embodies the essence of South Florida luxury living, creating a retreat that is as visually stunning as it is functionally flawless.
